description:
SeedLegals is the world’s most powerful legal and fundraising platform.

Connect ChatGPT to your SeedLegals account to work with your company's equity and legal documents. Ask about your cap table ownership, dilution, share classes, and SEIS/EIS scheme breakdowns, and see outstanding actions across your workflows. Find, read, and ask questions about your agreements, check who still needs to sign, send signature reminders, and share documents with your team. You can also create and update documents such as board minutes and employment agreements, directly from the conversation.

defaultPrompt: Who are the shareholders in Acme Ltd and what percentage does each own?
What’s outstanding for Acme right now?
Who still needs to sign the board resolution, or has it been fully signed?
